dct_description_sm: Representation of the administrative arterial network of the City of Montreal from the geobase, as defined by the regulation identifying arterial and local road networks (02-003). The City's arterial network is under the responsibility of the city council. All other streets or roads that belong to the City of Montreal and that do not form the City's arterial network are the responsibility of the borough councils in which they are located.**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
